snapshot_sufficient_unless_currentness_r.rule: snapshot evidence may answer stable historical/definitional questions; current-state claims require later evidence when material

version_bound.rule: resolve an exact version, edition, release, standard, instrument, dataset, or model revision before asserting version-sensitive behavior

effective_date_bound.rule: resolve effective/in-force/decision dates before asserting temporally scoped authority

live_when_material.rule: when the answer depends on current guidance, threat state, policy, implementation, or regulator status, live primary-source resolution is required

rules: freshness is claim-relative, not a universal time-to-live
stale does not mean false; it means insufficient for an explicitly current claim
a newer secondary source does not automatically outrank an older still-controlling primary authority
when version or temporal scope cannot be resolved, weaken the claim or return MODE_UNRESOLVED
